chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan from Abu al-Maghra' from Salama ibn Muhriz who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) when a man called Abu al-Ward came to him and said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'May Allah have mercy on you! If only you would rest your body from the carriage (of travel).'
So Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'O Abu al-Ward! I love to witness the benefits which Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said.'
That they may witness benefits for them
Indeed, no one witnesses them except that Allah benefits him. As for you, you return with forgiveness granted to you, and as for others, they are protected regarding their families and their wealth.

key_terms.الْمَحْمِل: The carriage or burden of travel, referring to the physical effort of Hajj
key_terms.الْمَنَافِع: Benefits, referring to the spiritual and material gains of Hajj

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of performing Hajj according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) cites Quran 22:28 to justify his active participation in Hajj rituals, emphasizing that witnessing the 'benefits' (manafi') brings divine favor to the pilgrim. He contrasts this with those who remain behind, noting that while pilgrims receive forgiveness, non-pilgrims are rewarded with protection for their families and wealth, illustrating the complementary spiritual and worldly rewards of the Hajj season.
